g.text: All models agree: accuracy of the auto-labels
Correct predictions / auto-labelled samples; values are percentages.
Each colour is a fixed model group; every model in that group must agree.
n/a = group incomplete. — = no samples accepted, so accuracy is undefined. Bar labels round to whole percentages.
Mixed3 = emotion2vec+ + Gemini + Qwen2.5-Omni. SER+API7 = five SER + GPT + Gemini.
All10 adds Qwen2.5-Omni, Qwen2-Audio and Gemma 4 to SER+API7.
